description: This is a Java Spring Boot REST controller class named CustomerController, handling HTTP requests related to customer operations in a banking application.

classes.name: CustomerController
classes.description: RestController managing customer-related endpoints in the banking application.

methods.name: getAllCustomers
methods.description: Handles GET request to fetch all customer details.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Handles POST request to add a new customer.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Handles GET request to fetch customer details by customer number.

methods.name: updateCustomer
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update customer information.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove a customer and related accounts.
